args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0 in all regions

trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Diagnosed**: `checkout-api` v2.3.1 was unhealthy in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate following the latest deploy.
2. **Rolled back**: Deployed **v2.3.0** — the most recent release that was healthy in production — to all three regions.
3. **Verified recovery**: The service is now healthy across all regions running v2.3.0, with the error rate down to 0.2%.
4. **Opened incident**: SEV2 incident **INC-0001** filed for checkout-api documenting the health check failures, the rollback, and the recovery. The on-call engineer has been paged.

No change-manager approval was needed since v2.3.0 was previously healthy in production. Root cause investigation of the v2.3.1 build should follow.
